---
title: "Eclipses by country"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

eclipse_data <- read_csv("data/formatted_eclipses.csv")

plot_ly(
  eclipse_data,
  type = "densitymapbox",
  lat = ~Latitude,
  lon = ~Longitude,
  radius = 20,
  hoverinfo = "none"
) |>
  layout(
    mapbox = list(
      style = "open-street-map",
      center = list(
        lon = 0,
        lat = 0
      ),
      zoom = 1
    )
  )
```
